tiered-pgo-jit-optimization.title: Understand JIT optimization with tiered PGO
tiered-pgo-jit-optimization.short: Use runtime profiles to re-optimize frequently executed paths
tiered-pgo-jit-optimization.summary: Tiered PGO lets the JIT use observed types, branches, and other runtime profile data to optimize hot methods more aggressively.
tiered-pgo-jit-optimization.why: It explains warmup behavior and helps interpret benchmarks that differ between startup and steady-state execution.
tiered-pgo-jit-optimization.tips: Measure realistic warmup and workloads before changing low-level JIT settings.

efcore-n-plus-one-query.title: Avoid N+1 queries in EF Core
efcore-n-plus-one-query.short: Do not issue one related-data query for every row in a loop
efcore-n-plus-one-query.summary: An N+1 query occurs when one query loads parent rows and accessing related data then triggers another query for each parent.
efcore-n-plus-one-query.why: Round trips and database work grow with the result count even though the application code may look harmless locally.
efcore-n-plus-one-query.tips: Choose eager loading, projection, or explicit bulk loading as appropriate and inspect the generated SQL and query count.

collectionsmarshal-dictionary-ref-update.title: Update Dictionary values by ref with CollectionsMarshal
collectionsmarshal-dictionary-ref-update.short: Avoid repeated lookup and value copies in measured hot paths
collectionsmarshal-dictionary-ref-update.summary: GetValueRefOrAddDefault exposes a reference to a Dictionary value so aggregation code can update the stored value directly.
collectionsmarshal-dictionary-ref-update.why: It can remove duplicate lookups in hot aggregation loops but relies more strongly on collection internals than normal APIs.
collectionsmarshal-dictionary-ref-update.tips: Do not mutate the Dictionary while holding the reference, keep its lifetime short, and use this only when measurement justifies it.

channel-fullmode-overload-policy.title: Choose a full-mode policy for bounded Channels
channel-fullmode-overload-policy.short: Decide whether overload should wait or discard data
channel-fullmode-overload-policy.summary: A bounded Channel can wait for capacity or discard old or new items when it becomes full.
channel-fullmode-overload-policy.why: The policy defines system behavior under overload, trading latency and producer backpressure against intentional data loss.
channel-fullmode-overload-policy.tips: Do not use a lossy telemetry policy for work such as orders or commands that must be processed.

stackalloc-loop-stack-growth.title: Avoid repeated stackalloc inside loops
stackalloc-loop-stack-growth.short: Reuse stack storage when repeated allocation can accumulate
stackalloc-loop-stack-growth.summary: Repeated stackalloc operations inside a loop can keep consuming stack space until the method returns and eventually exhaust it for large iteration counts.
stackalloc-loop-stack-growth.why: An optimization intended to avoid heap allocation can turn input size into a reliability problem.
stackalloc-loop-stack-growth.tips: Reuse fixed scratch space where possible and consider ArrayPool for larger or variable buffers.

runtimefeature-dynamic-code-aot.title: Detect dynamic-code support with RuntimeFeature
runtimefeature-dynamic-code-aot.short: Select an AOT-compatible path when runtime code generation is unavailable
runtimefeature-dynamic-code-aot.summary: RuntimeFeature.IsDynamicCodeSupported can separate implementations that require runtime code generation from alternatives that work in AOT environments.
runtimefeature-dynamic-code-aot.why: Libraries using expression compilation or dynamic generation can provide predictable behavior under NativeAOT.
runtimefeature-dynamic-code-aot.tips: Runtime detection alone does not make code trimming-safe; also address analyzer warnings and provide statically discoverable dependencies.

regex-nonbacktracking-redos.title: Use non-backtracking Regex to limit pathological matching
regex-nonbacktracking-redos.short: Reduce input-dependent backtracking blowups where the pattern is compatible
regex-nonbacktracking-redos.summary: RegexOptions.NonBacktracking provides linear-time matching behavior for supported patterns instead of relying on the traditional backtracking engine.
regex-nonbacktracking-redos.why: For untrusted input, pathological matching can become a denial-of-service performance problem.
regex-nonbacktracking-redos.tips: Check feature limitations, keep a timeout where appropriate, and test adversarial long inputs.

aspnetcore-response-compression-tradeoff.title: Balance ASP.NET Core response compression costs
aspnetcore-response-compression-tradeoff.short: Trade network bytes for CPU work based on response characteristics
aspnetcore-response-compression-tradeoff.summary: Response compression can reduce transfer size for compressible content but consumes CPU and does not benefit every payload.
aspnetcore-response-compression-tradeoff.why: Its value depends on bandwidth, response size, CPU headroom, and where compression is performed in the deployment.
aspnetcore-response-compression-tradeoff.tips: Skip formats that are already compressed and coordinate application compression with reverse proxies and CDNs.

cancellationtoken-linked-lifetime.title: Combine lifetimes with linked CancellationTokens
cancellationtoken-linked-lifetime.short: Propagate request, shutdown, and other cancellation sources as one token
cancellationtoken-linked-lifetime.summary: CreateLinkedTokenSource produces a token that is canceled when any of its source tokens is canceled.
cancellationtoken-linked-lifetime.why: It gives downstream operations one consistent cancellation signal when work is governed by several independent lifetimes.
cancellationtoken-linked-lifetime.tips: Dispose the linked CancellationTokenSource and avoid retaining links longer than the operation requires.

unity-physics-nonalloc-query-buffer.title: Reuse buffers for frequent Unity physics queries
unity-physics-nonalloc-query-buffer.short: Avoid allocating a result array on every frame
unity-physics-nonalloc-query-buffer.summary: For frequent physics queries, reusable result buffers and non-allocating query forms can avoid repeated temporary array allocation.
unity-physics-nonalloc-query-buffer.why: Temporary arrays in Update-style hot paths can create GC work and unstable frame times.
unity-physics-nonalloc-query-buffer.tips: A full buffer can truncate results, so measure expected hit counts and detect capacity exhaustion when correctness depends on all hits.
